5 of the 15 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Solana: from $350,000. For the other 10, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 12 of the 15.

items.t: REDMA rescission and deposits — central to this page: under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act s. 21, a purchaser may rescind a purchase agreement by serving written notice on the developer within seven days after the later of the date the purchase agreement was made and the date the developer obtained the purchaser's receipt for the Disclosure Statement; under s. 15 the developer must give each purchaser a copy of the filed Disclosure Statement, and any filed amendment, before entering into the agreement; deposits are held in trust under s. 18.

Municipal zoning and plans — two Langleys, kept separate: Langley presales sit in either the Township of Langley or the City of Langley, with different bylaws. Township: the Official Community Plan is Langley OCP Bylaw 1979 No. 1842 as amended, most recently by the 2025 OCP Update, Bylaw No. 6200, adopted December 1, 2025; zoning is under Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 as amended, including SSMUH Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024; 3 units at ≤280 m² and 4 units at 280–4,050 m² on eligible lots, NO 6-plex tier; suite cap 120 m²). The Willoughby Community Plan is Bylaw 1836 (1979) in origin, now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200. Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 received first and second reading only on May 25, 2026 — they are not adopted law in any source opened.

GST and rebates — the presale tax core: 5% GST applies to new construction (a presale completes as a new home), not resales. First-Time Home Buyers' GST/HST Rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122) — 100% of GST to $1M, maximum $50,000, phasing to $1.5M, agreements March 20, 2025–2031. GST New Housing Rebate 36% / maximum $6,300 / $350,000–$450,000 phase-out. Worked example, with its inputs stated: on a $1,000,000 newly constructed home bought by an eligible first-time buyer under an agreement in the Bill C-4 window, GST at 5% is $50,000 and the FTHB rebate at 100% (price at the $1M full-rebate ceiling) returns $50,000, for net GST of $0 before any other taxes or adjustments — inputs: $1,000,000 price, 5% GST, eligible first-time buyer, agreement date in window; any price above $1M phases the rebate down to zero at $1.5M.

The two tax breaks stack from different governments and different eligibility tests. The BC Newly Built Home Exemption (full to $1,100,000, partial to $1,150,000) does not require first-time-buyer status; the federal FTHB GST rebate (100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M) does — a non-first-time presale buyer can still be fully PTT-exempt while getting no GST rebate.

Langley City's presale geography is a transit designation, not just marketing. The Township's one Transit-Oriented Area on 196 Street in Willowbrook, for the proposed Surrey-Langley SkyTrain station, was designated by provincial Order-in-Council on May 2, 2025, with minimum allowable densities of 8–20 storeys within 800 m depending on proximity — the density floor behind "near the future SkyTrain" project claims on that corridor.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in New Construction Presales in Langley BC

items.t: REDMA — the presale frame (applies to every Langley presale, either municipality): under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act, a purchaser may rescind a purchase agreement by serving written notice on the developer within seven days after the later of the date the purchase agreement was made and the date the developer obtained the purchaser's receipt for the Disclosure Statement (s.21); a developer must give each purchaser a copy of the filed Disclosure Statement, and any filed amendment, before entering into the agreement (s.15); deposits must be held in trust as s.18 requires.

Township frame (projects on Township ground ONLY): Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw 1987 No. 2500 governs. SSMUH — Township Bylaw 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units on lots up to 280 m² and 4 units on lots under 4,050 m², eligibility requires municipal water and sewer, and NO 6-plex tier exists in Bylaw 6020. Secondary suite cap 120 m²; a coach house is a fee-simple second unit under s.102 — never strata (LIVE CONFLICT — flagged, not resolved: s.102, July 2025, permits townhouse suites at 120 m², while the Township's January 2025 guide says townhouse suites are not permitted). R-CL s.403: 220 m² minimum lot area to 464.5 m² maximum LOT area — no "355 m²" figure exists. Subdivision and servicing: Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw 2019 No. 5382 — CONFIRMED; subdivisions are approved by the Approving Officer under the Land Title Act. Willoughby Plan 1836 became Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 reached first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY, Public Hearing directed June 15, 2026 — never upgrade reading-stage bylaws.

Langley City frame (projects on City ground ONLY — never imported into Township ground): Langley City Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300, cited by number (adoption date not verified); SSMUH Bylaw 3284; secondary suite = the lesser of 100 m² and 40%.

ALR block (where ALR ground exists — parcel status not confirmed per parcel): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

Strata block (a completed bare-land strata lot, where one exists): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. None of this exists yet for an unbuilt presale unit at signing — see the REDMA block above.

: full exemption at fair market value ≤$1,100,000, partial phasing out over the $50,000 range above it, complete elimination at $1,150,000, effective April 1, 2024 — and the buyer does not need to be a first-time buyer. FTHB PTT exemption: first $500,000 exempt, full at value ≤$835,000 (max saving $8,000), partial to $860,000.
